away.summary: The Mammoth (10-6-1) are wrapping up a five-game road trip in Ottawa after a 5-4 overtime loss to Montreal on Thursday. They are dealing with several defensive injuries, including Nate Schmidt (upper body), John Marino (upper body), and Maveric Lamoureux (shoulder), while Kailer Yamamoto remains on IR. Defenseman Gregor Biber was recalled from Tucson after Schmidt's injury, and Ben McCartney is also scratched.

home.summary: The Senators (10-6-1) are 1-2 over their last three games and will be without starting goalie Linus Ullmark, who is close but not ready to return. Samuel Ersson is projected to start in net. Coach Travis Green indicated there will be a couple of game-time decisions, with Ridly Greig day to day and Tyler Kleven potentially returning from illness. Nikolas Matinpalo is scratched.
